environment.description: Application container runs in an ECS Fargate task within a VPC private subnet (10.0.128.0/20). The subnet route table has entries only for local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) and a VPC endpoint for ECR (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr). There is NO NAT Gateway, NO Internet Gateway route, and NO other VPC endpoints configured. The Security Group attached to the Fargate task allows inbound only from the internal ALB security group on port 3000, and egress rules allow only TCP 443 to the prefix list for the ECR VPC endpoint (pl-63a5400a). The internal ALB is not internet-facing and is accessible only from within the VPC via a PrivateLink endpoint shared with the frontend service. APP_SECRET is injected from AWS Secrets Manager via the ECS task definition secretsmanagement integration (arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789:secret:app/master-key).

config.security_group_egress: TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a (ECR endpoint prefix list only)
config.alb_access: via PrivateLink from frontend VPC only
config.secret_source: AWS Secrets Manager via ECS task definition
